wiki.title: Jerry L. O'Connor
wiki.extract: Jerry L. O'Connor (born September 14, 1953) is an American Republican politician and retired banker from Fond du Lac, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 60th Assembly district since 2025; he previously represented the 52nd Assembly district from 2023 to 2025. He was the president and C.E.O. of the National Exchange Bank & Trust of Waupun, Wisconsin, from 1998 until his retirement in 2020.
